sources.name: Luis Taz
sources.quote: I navigated through a bunch of systems on Wednesday night, like Nova Terra and Sirius, then headed towards Lacaille 9352. I kept moving, trying to mine what I could and avoid getting caught in the fights that popped up. I went through Grumium, Celaeno, Lanternwick, Diadem, and a few others, mining copper ore and iron ore along the way. My goal was to come out even, and I managed to do that, so it was a good run.
